children: AIRWA INC. reported fiscal 2026 revenue of $25.8M, up 101% from $12.8M a year earlier, while reporting a net loss attributable to controlling interest of $(17.56M) and diluted loss per share of $(752.73) for the year, according to its Form 10-K.
Revenue was $25.81M for FY 2026, compared with $12.82M in FY 2025; YoY change 101%.
Net income (net loss attributable to controlling interest) was $(17.56M) for FY 2026, compared with net income $3.49M in FY 2025.
Diluted EPS was $(752.73) per share for FY 2026, compared with $10,842.51 per share for FY 2025.
Revenue growth was driven by new AI services and advertising businesses; total reported revenue roughly doubled to $25.8M in FY2026.
Launched advertising services that generated approximately $12.0M and expanded AI offerings following the January 2026 acquisition of Rafael AI.
Technology licensing royalties contributed about $7.3M; AI and advertising initiatives strengthened market positioning.
Completed the Best Life acquisition in July 2026 (closing) and invested in digital assets and USDT to support acquisitions and operational expansion.
